definitions.explanation: Something offered to a deity, spirit, or respected person as a gift of devotion, gratitude, or sacrifice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{捧|ささ}げ{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}した→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: I prepared an offering for the gods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭壇|さいだん}→祭壇：13739_saidan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{捧|ささ}げ{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}べられていた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: Offerings were arranged on the altar.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{亡|な}き⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{捧|ささ}げ{物|もの}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{書|か}かれた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: This work was written as a tribute to the late master.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{捧|ささ}げる→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧ (to offer; to dedicate) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing). Used in both religious and secular contexts. In religious usage, it refers to physical offerings placed at altars or shrines. In secular usage, it can refer to a creative work, performance, or gesture dedicated to someone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{捧|ささ}げ{物|もの}: offering to the gods
- ⟦{祭壇|さいだん}→祭壇：13739_saidan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{捧|ささ}げ{物|もの}: altar offering
- {捧|ささ}げ{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make an offering

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{供|そな}え{物|もの}→供え物：18160_sonaemono⟧: offering (at a shrine, grave, or altar) — the more common everyday word for offerings placed at Buddhist altars or graves
- {貢|みつ}ぎ{物|もの}: tribute — specifically something given to a superior or ruler, often implying obligation
- ⟦{奉納|ほうのう}→奉納：12200_hounou⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: votive offering — a formal offering dedicated to a shrine or temple
